title: Dynamic prediction of incident postoperative acute kidney injury in surgical intensive care
description: Reproducible code for dynamic prediction of serum-creatinine-defined incident postoperative acute kidney injury using MIMIC-IV and eICU, including temporal and external validation, recalibration, competing-risk analyses, training-only nested subject-grouped model-selection auditing, and eICU outcome-observability and selection-bias sensitivities. No patient-level data are included.
